description: Returns percentiles (p10, p25, median, p75, p90, min, max) and the unit of facial measurements from 102 adult faces (49 women, 53 men) of the Face Research Lab London Set, measured with a 478-point MediaPipe landmarker, plus citation and license. Use this when you need a number (e.g. median fWHR or pupillary distance by sex); use classify_face_shape to label one face's shape, get_face_type for what a type means, and get_methodology for how a measure is computed. Aggregates only; one research set photographed in one city, so these describe these faces, not a population. Read-only; unknown measure or group values are rejected with a validation error.

group.description: Which faces: all (all faces), female (women only) or male (men only). Omit to get all three groups side by side.

measure.description: One measure: composite (score, points 0-100), symmetry (percent), golden (golden ratio fit, percent), fwhr (facial width-to-height ratio), midface (midface ratio), pd (pupillary distance, mm), tilt (canthal tilt, degrees). Omit to get all seven.

name: get_reference_statistics
title: Face measurement statistics
